events.title: Firefox 3.0 released
events.summary: Mozilla shipped Firefox 3.0 on June 17, 2008 with a new Places bookmark/history system, improved security, and a Guinness World Record download day.
events.about: Firefox 3 refined the browser that broke IE's monopoly: smarter address bar suggestions, malware protection, and lower memory use. Its launch day set a record for software downloads — signaling open-source browsers as mass-market products.

narrative.whyChosen: Firefox 3 was the peak mindshare moment before Chrome's rise.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved Mozilla could ship polished consumer software at massive scale.
narrative.problemSolved: Firefox 2's memory leaks and basic bookmarking lagged user expectations as the web grew richer.
